title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons

translated_title: RegimeCouncil：面向LLM智能体记忆冲突治理的成对证据路由方法
translated_abstract: 语言智能体依赖长期记忆来在长程交互中实现个性化响应，然而随着世界的变化，存储的事实会悄然过时，而智能体往往只有在基于过时记录采取行动之后，才通过延迟反馈得知使用记忆带来了损害。在记忆库被更新之前，这种负面反馈应该传播多远：是仅在针对同一事实的未来查询中抑制记忆使用（局部策略），还是也应跨及其他存储事实（全局策略）？现有记忆系统在设计阶段就隐式地固定了这两种共享范围之一。我们将这种在有效性隐藏、反馈延迟条件下的在线范围选择问题形式化为“记忆冲突治理”，并证明任何一种固定策略单独使用都不足以应对。随后我们提出RegimeCouncil，一个轻量级的成对证据路由器，它将两种范围保留为“顾问”，并在无需重新训练LLM的情况下在线地在两者之间进行仲裁。（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RegimeCouncil——一个无需重训LLM的轻量级成对证据路由器，将“记忆冲突治理”形式化，并在局部与全局两种记忆抑制策略之间在线仲裁，以解决长期记忆悄然过时与延迟反馈下负面经验传播范围难以确定的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that formulates memory conflict governance and arbitrates online between local and global memory-suppression policies without retraining the LLM, addressing stale long-term memory under hidden validity and delayed feedback.
